versions.changelog:
- Initial release of diff4 skill for secure diff and file sharing.
- Supports encrypting and sharing git diffs (`git-latest`, `git-staged`) and arbitrary files via the diff4 CLI.
- Client-side AES-256-GCM encryption ensures only holders of the passphrase can decrypt shared content.
- Server URL and passphrase configurable via flags or environment variables.
- Key generation and retrieval available through `diff4 key-gen` and `diff4 key-get`.
- Notifies on edge cases like empty diffs and unsupported binary files.
